Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 9: the slip of [[Imperial Stormtrooper (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Clone. Blaster Rifle deploys (and fires) for free on this trooper. When this trooper fires Blaster Rifle, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one (may take the other into hand). Immune to Rebel Barrier.”), word for word the text of [[Imperial Stormtrooper (V)]]. The label under the slip reads “Stormtrooper (V)”, as printed in the Master List.<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
